Name: LivingNPCs
Description:
[i]Your villagers remember, feel, and quietly act on what happens between you.[/i]
[i]让村民记住、在意，并悄悄回应你们之间发生的一切。[/i]

[size=5][b][u]English[/u][/b][/size]

LivingNPCs turns AI dialogue into an ongoing relationship system for Stardew Valley. Villagers can remember past conversations, carry emotions, respect relationship pacing, notice the world around them, ask for help, exchange small gifts, and sometimes join you for a short outing. The goal is not just more dialogue, but conversations that can matter later.

[list]
[*][b]Mod ID:[/b] Yuki.LivingNPCs[/*]
[*][b]Nexus author:[/b] 3111471949[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]What it adds[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Type your own conversations.[/b] Hold LeftAlt and interact with an NPC to open a free-text prompt. Normal right-click dialogue remains vanilla by default, and can optionally be changed to AI dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]Long-term memory.[/b] NPCs can remember facts, preferences, dislikes, nicknames, promises, boundaries, shared moments, and unresolved issues, then recall the relevant parts later.[/*]
[*][b]Emotion and relationship pacing.[/b] Responses consider vanilla hearts, conversation history, trust, longer emotions, and recent conflict. New acquaintances should not immediately behave like lifelong friends, and apologies or thoughtful follow-ups can gradually repair tension.[/*]
[*][b]Community impressions.[/b] Important interactions can leave limited impressions with witnesses and close social circles. Retellings decay over time instead of instantly making the whole town omniscient.[/*]
[*][b]Personal help requests.[/b] NPCs may occasionally request a suitable item. Once clearly accepted, the request appears in the vanilla quest log and only completes when the correct item is actually delivered.[/*]
[*][b]Gifts, money, and personal mail.[/b] Under local friendship, value, cooldown, and item checks, an NPC may offer a small gift, a little money, or a rarer meaningful gift. Birthday, reciprocal, and thank-you mail can be written in character, with stable templates as fallback.[/*]
[*][b]Companion outings.[/b] An NPC can accept a clear invitation, walk through real map boundaries to a supported destination, stay for a while, and then resume their schedule. Unsafe festival, event, sleep, weather, and map states are blocked.[/*]
[*][b]Small visible behaviors.[/b] Dialogue can influence restrained actions such as facing the player, showing an emote, approaching briefly, keeping distance, or responding more naturally at a mentioned place.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla and SVE context.[/b] English and Simplified Chinese biographies and progression context are provided for vanilla characters and Stardew Valley Expanded.[/*]
[*][b]Transcripts, token statistics, and diagnostics.[/b] Readable conversation memoirs, prompt/response logs, context-routing logs, debug exports, and per-save token tracking make long playthroughs easier to review and bug reports easier to reproduce.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — optional, strongly recommended[/*]
[*]An LLM provider/API, or a compatible local server you run yourself[/*]
[/list]LivingNPCs does not bundle an AI model or a free API. Cost, privacy, speed, and output quality depend on the provider and model you choose.

[size=4][b]Fresh installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Fully exit Stardew Valley and SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the mod.[/*]
[*]Put the [font=Courier New]LivingNPCs[/font] folder into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Check that the final path looks like [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/LivingNPCs/manifest.json[/font], without an extra nested LivingNPCs folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Open Generic Mod Config Menu, select LivingNPCs, and configure the AI Dialogue Engine section.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Upgrading from 0.1.x / migrating an existing save[/b][/size]

[color=orange][b]Complete the folder rename below before launching the new version for the first time.[/b][/color] This lets LivingNPCs find and import the compatible old configuration and folder data.

Back up your saves and old mod folders first, then:

[list=1]
[*]Fully exit Stardew Valley and SMAPI.[/*]
[*]In the game's Mods folder, rename the [b]outer legacy[/b] [font=Courier New]ValleyTalk[/font] folder so its name begins with a dot:

[font=Courier New]Mods/ValleyTalk/  →  Mods/.ValleyTalk/[/font]

If your old package has a nested [font=Courier New]ValleyTalk/ValleyTalk[/font] layout, rename the outer folder which contains the old engine and content packs. Do [b]not[/b] add a dot to the old LivingNPCs folder.[/*]
[*]Extract the new [font=Courier New]LivingNPCs[/font] folder into Mods, replacing the previous LivingNPCs folder. Do not keep two LivingNPCs versions active in different subfolders.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI and load every existing save you want to migrate once. In multiplayer, the host must load the save to migrate save data.[/*]
[*]If that save contains compatible legacy conversation data, an in-game message will say: [i]“LivingNPCs: migrated dialogue memories of N NPCs from ValleyTalk.”[/i] After seeing it, make one normal in-game save.[/*]
[/list]Migration can preserve compatible provider settings, NPC dialogue history, token-usage records, local farmhand history, and readable conversation transcripts. It never deletes the old files or legacy save keys automatically.

The renamed [font=Courier New].ValleyTalk[/font] folder is ignored by SMAPI. You may keep it as a backup, or delete it after confirming that the new version has the expected settings and histories. If you keep it, leave the leading dot in place.

[color=orange][b]Do not leave the old ValleyTalk mod active under its original name.[/b][/color] If legacy ValleyTalk is still loaded, LivingNPCs disables AI dialogue and postpones migration to prevent conflicts between the two dialogue systems.

A save with no old NPC dialogue history or token ledger may show no migration HUD message; that alone does not mean something failed. If the game reports a partial migration, keep [font=Courier New].ValleyTalk[/font], check the SMAPI log, and include it in your report.

[size=4][b]First-time AI setup[/b][/size]
[b]Supported providers:[/b] OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible services, Anthropic/Claude, Google/Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, VolcEngine/Doubao, and a self-hosted llama.cpp server.

[list=1]
[*]Open LivingNPCs in Generic Mod Config Menu and choose the LLM provider.[/*]
[*]If you changed provider, save once and reopen the menu. Changing provider clears the previous API key and refreshes the provider-specific fields.[/*]
[*]Enter the required API key, model name, and server address. llama.cpp requires a server you run yourself.[/*]
[*]Save and watch the SMAPI console for the non-blocking connection self-check.[/*]
[*]Load a save, approach an NPC, then hold [font=Courier New]LeftAlt[/font] while clicking or using the interaction button.[/*]
[/list]A failed self-check does not permanently disable dialogue; LivingNPCs tries again during a real conversation. HTTP 401/403 usually means a credential or permission problem, 429 usually means rate limiting or account limits, and timeouts usually point to the endpoint, network, or timeout setting.

LivingNPCs asks more of a model than plain chat because replies may also carry hidden structured information for memory, emotions, requests, and safe actions. Stronger models are generally more consistent. Smaller or cheaper models can work, but may have weaker continuity or roleplay.

[size=4][b]Controls and recommended configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]LeftAlt + interact:[/b] open typed AI dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]Normal right-click:[/b] remains vanilla by default. Enable “AI for normal right-click dialogue” if you want more AI-generated ambient lines.[/*]
[*][b]LeftShift + H:[/b] manually test one nearby small NPC behavior.[/*]
[*][b]LeftShift + J:[/b] print a nearby NPC's state and memory summary to the SMAPI console.[/*]
[*]Leave semantic context routing enabled for normal play. Shorter prompt options can reduce token use, but may also remove useful detail.[/*]
[*]Disable “AI world actions” if you want generated conversations without gifts, money, or outings affecting the game.[/*]
[*]Help requests, small/meaningful gifts, money, outings, extra friendship, passive behaviors, AI frequencies, and SVE context can be tuned separately.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
Type these in the SMAPI console:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_debug [near|NPC][/font] — state, behavior reasons, request fit, and memory recall.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_prompt [near|NPC][/font] — hidden context prepared for LivingNPCs dialogue generation.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_export [near|all|NPC][/font] — export a Markdown diagnostic report.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_eval[/font] — run a lightweight rule sanity check.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_giftmail[/font] — inspect gift-mail state and generated text.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_forget [near|NPC|all confirm][/font] — clear behavior memory and built-in AI conversation history.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens [export|reset][/font] — view, export, or reset LLM usage statistics for the current save.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]livingnpcs_purge_valleytalk confirm[/font] — optional, permanent cleanup of retained legacy save keys after migration; host only.[/*]
[/list]The forget, reset, and purge operations delete data. Back up the save and check the target before using them.

[size=4][b]AI, privacy, local logs, and cost[/b][/size]

Your typed text and the game context needed for the reply are sent to the LLM provider you configure. This can include the NPC, relationship, date, location, weather, progression, recent conversations, and relevant memories.

The API key is stored only in [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/config.json[/font] and is not written to LivingNPCs logs. Never post or share your API key.

For review and troubleshooting, LivingNPCs saves local files under [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs[/font], including readable [font=Courier New]conversation_logs[/font] and, by default, [font=Courier New]prompt_logs[/font], [font=Courier New]ai_response_logs[/font], and [font=Courier New]context_routing_logs[/font]. These files may contain your conversations and game information. Review and redact them before sharing. AI diagnostic export can be disabled by setting [font=Courier New]ExportAiResponseLogs[/font] to false in config.json.

Semantic routing, the final reply, AI-written mail, and long-term memory compression can all use model calls. Use [font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens[/font] to inspect usage. Your provider determines billing and data handling.

[size=4][b]Compatibility notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Vanilla and SVE character/progression support is built in, in English and Simplified Chinese.[/*]
[*]Third-party NPCs can use a conservative fallback, but characters without dedicated profiles may be less detailed.[/*]
[*]LivingNPCs respects content authors' AI-use permissions. Text from content packs which do not permit AI use is not copied into AI prompt context.[/*]
[*]This release does not claim dedicated, hand-tuned support for other large expansions such as Ridgeside Village or East Scarp.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Feedback[/b][/size]

LivingNPCs is still evolving. If you find a bug, encounter unnatural NPC behavior, have a migration or compatibility problem, notice a translation issue, or simply have an idea for improving the gameplay and future features, please leave a Nexus comment or Bug Report.

A clear example helps enormously. If possible, include the game/SMAPI/mod versions, NPC name, in-game date/time/weather, location, your input, the NPC reply, screenshots, reproduction steps, and a parsed SMAPI log link from [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]. Check diagnostic files for private conversation content before sharing, and never include your API key.

[list=1]

[size=4][b]AI、隐私、本地日志与费用[/b][/size]

你的自由输入和生成回复所需的游戏上下文会发送给所配置的 LLM 服务商，其中可能包含 NPC、关系、日期、地点、天气、游戏进度、近期对话与相关记忆。

API Key 只保存在 [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs/config.json[/font]，不会被写入 LivingNPCs 日志。请永远不要公开或分享 API Key。

为方便回顾与排错，LivingNPCs 会在 [font=Courier New]Mods/LivingNPCs[/font] 下保存本地文件，包括可读的 [font=Courier New]conversation_logs[/font]，以及默认开启的 [font=Courier New]prompt_logs[/font]、[font=Courier New]ai_response_logs[/font] 和 [font=Courier New]context_routing_logs[/font]。这些文件可能包含你的对话和游戏信息，分享前请检查并删改隐私内容。若不希望持续导出 AI 诊断日志，可在 config.json 中把 [font=Courier New]ExportAiResponseLogs[/font] 设为 false。

语义路由、正式回复、AI 信件和长期记忆压缩都可能产生模型调用。可用 [font=Courier New]livingnpcs_tokens[/font] 查看用量；计费与数据处理规则由服务商决定。

[size=4][b]兼容说明[/b][/size]
[list]

[*]第三方 NPC 可以使用保守回退；没有专属资料的角色深度可能较低。[/*]

LivingNPCs 仍在持续完善。如果你发现错误、角色表现不自然、迁移或兼容问题、翻译问题，或者对玩法和后续扩展有任何建议，欢迎在 Nexus 的 Posts 页面留言或提交 Bug Report。

清晰的例子非常有帮助。请尽量附上游戏/SMAPI/Mod 版本、NPC 名称、游戏内日期/时间/天气、地点、你的输入、NPC 回复、截图、复现步骤，以及通过 [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] 上传后的 SMAPI 日志链接。分享诊断文件前请先检查私人对话内容，并且永远不要附上 API Key。
